derivation: a prolonged form of a primary verb, which is only used as an alternate in certain tenses;
kjv_def: his lot be, cast lots, obtain
strongs_def: to lot, i.e. determine (by implication, receive) especially by lot
it_def:
1) ottenere tirando a sorte
   1a) ricevere per assegnazione divina, ottenere
2) tirare a sorte, determinare tirando a sorte
